title: Stream envelope
description: Live-polling envelope for an endpoint whose list only grows at its end, such as a log. A poll gets only the entries after its cursor, so a long list is not sent again each time it grows. The cursor is opaque; clients echo the last cursor on the next poll and treat any unknown status value as "reset". This generic envelope permits additional properties so an endpoint may extend it; a tab schema may pin those extensions.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor token. Echo it back on the next poll. It moves forward with the entries the client received; a cursor from another list, or from before the list was cleared, gets a reset.

status.description: delta = items are the entries after the cursor: append them. unchanged = no new entry, items omitted. reset = replace everything the client has with items, which are the last entries of the list.

items.description: Present for reset and delta, oldest first. An endpoint can send a delta in pages: poll again with the returned cursor until the status is unchanged. Element shape is endpoint-specific.

dropped.description: Present for delta: how many entries the list evicted before this client received them. They come before the first item.

state.description: Optional endpoint-specific observable state. Tab schemas pin the exact shape.
